headings.title: The Testimony of John the Baptist

verses.text: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: He was in the beginning with God;
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: all things were made through him, and without him was not anything made that was made.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: In him was life, and the life was the light of men.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: There was a man sent from God, whose name was John.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: He came for testimony, to bear witness to the light, that all might believe through him.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: He was not the light, but came to bear witness to the light.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: The true light that enlightens every man was coming into the world.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: He was in the world, and the world was made through him, yet the world knew him not.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: He came to his own home, and his own people received him not.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: But to all who received him, who believed in his name, he gave power to become children of God;
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: who were born, not of blood nor of the will of the flesh nor of the will of man, but of God.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: And the Word became flesh and dwelt among us, full of grace and truth; we have beheld his glory, glory as of the only-begotten Son from the Father.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: (John bore witness to him, and cried, “This was he of whom I said, ‘He who comes after me ranks before me, for he was before me.’”)
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: And from his fulness have we all received, grace upon grace.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: No one has ever seen God; the only-begotten Son, who is in the bosom of the Father, he has made him known.
verses.heading: The Word Became Flesh

verses.text: And this is the testimony of John, when the Jews sent priests and Levites from Jerusalem to ask him, “Who are you?”
verses.heading: The Testimony of John the Baptist

verses.text: He confessed, he did not deny, but confessed, “I am not the Christ.”
verses.heading: The Testimony of John the Baptist

verses.text: And they asked him, “What then? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the prophet?” And he answered, “No.”
verses.heading: The Testimony of John the Baptist

verses.text: They said to him then, “Who are you? Let us have an answer for those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
verses.heading: The Testimony of John the Baptist

verses.text: He said, “I am the voice of one crying in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way of the Lord,’ as the prophet Isaiah said.”
verses.heading: The Testimony of John the Baptist

verses.text: Now they had been sent from the Pharisees.
verses.heading: The Testimony of John the Baptist

verses.text: They asked him, “Then why are you baptizing, if you are neither the Christ, nor Elijah, nor the prophet?”
verses.heading: The Testimony of John the Baptist

verses.text: John answered them, “I baptize with water; but among you stands one whom you do not know,
verses.heading: The Testimony of John the Baptist

verses.text: even he who comes after me, the thong of whose sandal I am not worthy to untie.”
verses.heading: The Testimony of John the Baptist

verses.text: This took place in Bethany beyond the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
verses.heading: The Testimony of John the Baptist

verses.text: The next day he saw Jesus coming toward him, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
verses.heading: The Lamb of God

verses.text: This is he of whom I said, ‘After me comes a man who ranks before me, for he was before me.’
verses.heading: The Lamb of God

verses.text: I myself did not know him; but for this I came baptizing with water, that he might be revealed to Israel.”
verses.heading: The Lamb of God

verses.text: And John bore witness, “I saw the Spirit descend as a dove from heaven and remain on him.
verses.heading: The Lamb of God

verses.text: I myself did not know him; but he who sent me to baptize with water said to me, ‘He on whom you see the Spirit descend and remain, this is he who baptizes with the Holy Spirit.’
verses.heading: The Lamb of God

verses.text: And I have seen and have borne witness that this is the Son of God.”
verses.heading: The Lamb of God

verses.text: The next day again John was standing with two of his disciples;
verses.heading: The First Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: and he looked at Jesus as he walked, and said, “Behold, the Lamb of God!”
verses.heading: The First Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: The two disciples heard him say this, and they followed Jesus.
verses.heading: The First Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: Jesus turned, and saw them following, and said to them, “What do you seek?” And they said to him, “Rabbi” (which means Teacher), “where are you staying?”
verses.heading: The First Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: He said to them, “Come and see.” They came and saw where he was staying; and they stayed with him that day, for it was about the tenth hour.
verses.heading: The First Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: One of the two who heard John speak, and followed him, was Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother.
verses.heading: The First Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: He first found his brother Simon, and said to him, “We have found the Messiah” (which means Christ).
verses.heading: The First Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: He brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him, and said, “So you are Simon the son of John? You shall be called Cephas” (which means Peter).
verses.heading: The First Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: The next day Jesus decided to go to Galilee. And he found Philip and said to him, “Follow me.”
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael

verses.text: Now Philip was from Beth-saida, the city of Andrew and Peter.
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael

verses.text: Philip found Nathana-el, and said to him, “We have found him of whom Moses in the law and also the prophets wrote, Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael

verses.text: Nathana-el said to him, “Can anything good come out of Nazareth?” Philip said to him, “Come and see.”
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael

verses.text: Jesus saw Nathana-el coming to him, and said of him, “Behold, an Israelite indeed, in whom is no guile!”
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael

verses.text: Nathana-el said to him, “How do you know me?” Jesus answered him, “Before Philip called you, when you were under the fig tree, I saw you.”
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael

verses.text: Nathana-el answered him, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God! You are the King of Israel!”
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael

verses.text: Jesus answered him, “Because I said to you, I saw you under the fig tree, do you believe? You shall see greater things than these.”
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael

verses.text: And he said to him, “Truly, truly, I say to you, you will see heaven opened, and the angels of God ascending and descending upon the Son of man.”
verses.heading: Jesus Calls Philip and Nathanael

verses.text: On the third day there was a marriage at Cana in Galilee, and the mother of Jesus was there;
verses.heading: The Marriage at Cana

verses.text: Jesus also was invited to the marriage, with his disciples.
verses.heading: The Marriage at Cana

verses.text: When the wine failed, the mother of Jesus said to him, “They have no wine.”
verses.heading: The Marriage at Cana

verses.text: And Jesus said to her, “O woman, what have you to do with me? My hour has not yet come.”
verses.heading: The Marriage at Cana

verses.text: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever he tells you.”
verses.heading: The Marriage at Cana

verses.text: Now six stone jars were standing there, for the Jewish rites of purification, each holding twenty or thirty gallons.
verses.heading: The Marriage at Cana

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “Fill the jars with water.” And they filled them up to the brim.
verses.heading: The Marriage at Cana

verses.text: He said to them, “Now draw some out, and take it to the steward of the feast.” So they took it.
verses.heading: The Marriage at Cana

verses.text: When the steward of the feast tasted the water now become wine, and did not know where it came from (though the servants who had drawn the water knew), the steward of the feast called the bridegroom
verses.heading: The Marriage at Cana

verses.text: and said to him, “Every man serves the good wine first; and when men have drunk freely, then the poor wine; but you have kept the good wine until now.”
verses.heading: The Marriage at Cana

verses.text: This, the first of his signs, Jesus did at Cana in Galilee, and manifested his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
verses.heading: The Marriage at Cana

verses.text: After this he went down to Caperna-um, with his mother and his brethren and his disciples; and there they stayed for a few days.
verses.heading: The Marriage at Cana

verses.text: The Passover of the Jews was at hand, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: In the temple he found those who were selling oxen and sheep and pigeons, and the money-changers at their business.
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: And making a whip of cords, he drove them all, with the sheep and oxen, out of the temple; and he poured out the coins of the money-changers and overturned their tables.
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: And he told those who sold the pigeons, “Take these things away; you shall not make my Father’s house a house of trade.”
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: His disciples remembered that it was written, “Zeal for your house will consume me.”
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: The Jews then said to him, “What sign have you to show us for doing this?”
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and in three days I will raise it up.”
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: The Jews then said, “It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and will you raise it up in three days?”
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: But he spoke of the temple of his body.
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: When therefore he was raised from the dead, his disciples remembered that he had said this; and they believed the Scripture and the word which Jesus had spoken.
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: Now when he was in Jerusalem at the Passover feast, many believed in his name when they saw the signs which he did;
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: but Jesus did not trust himself to them,
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: because he knew all men and needed no one to bear witness of man; for he himself knew what was in man.
verses.heading: The Cleansing of the Temple

verses.text: Now there was a man of the Pharisees, named Nicodemus, a ruler of the Jews.
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: This man came to Jesus by night and said to him, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher come from God; for no one can do these signs that you do, unless God is with him.”
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: Jesus answered him, “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one is born anew, he cannot see the kingdom of God.”
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: Nicodemus said to him, “How can a man be born when he is old? Can he enter a second time into his mother’s womb and be born?”
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: Jesus answered, “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless one is born of water and the Spirit, he cannot enter the kingdom of God.
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: That which is born of the flesh is flesh, and that which is born of the Spirit is spirit.
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: Do not marvel that I said to you, ‘You must be born anew.’
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: The wind blows where it wills, and you hear the sound of it, but you do not know where it comes from or where it goes; so it is with every one who is born of the Spirit.”
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: Nicodemus said to him, “How can this be?”
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: Jesus answered him, “Are you a teacher of Israel, and yet you do not understand this?
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, we speak of what we know, and bear witness to what we have seen; but you do not receive our testimony.
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: If I have told you earthly things and you do not believe, how can you believe if I tell you heavenly things?
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: No one has ascended into heaven but he who descended from heaven, the Son of man.
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: And as Moses lifted up the serpent in the wilderness, so must the Son of man be lifted up,
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: that whoever believes in him may have eternal life.”
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: For God so loved the world that he gave his only-begotten Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish but have eternal life.
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: For God sent the Son into the world, not to condemn the world, but that the world might be saved through him.
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: He who believes in him is not condemned; he who does not believe is condemned already, because he has not believed in the name of the only-begotten Son of God.
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: And this is the judgment, that the light has come into the world, and men loved darkness rather than light, because their deeds were evil.
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: For every one who does evil hates the light, and does not come to the light, lest his deeds should be exposed.
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: But he who does what is true comes to the light, that it may be clearly seen that his deeds have been wrought in God.
verses.heading: Nicodemus Visits Jesus

verses.text: After this Jesus and his disciples went into the land of Judea; there he remained with them and baptized.
verses.heading: Jesus and John the Baptist

verses.text: John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was much water there; and people came and were baptized.
verses.heading: Jesus and John the Baptist

verses.text: For John had not yet been put in prison.
verses.heading: Jesus and John the Baptist

verses.text: Now a discussion arose between John’s disciples and a Jew over purifying.
verses.heading: Jesus and John the Baptist

verses.text: And they came to John, and said to him, “Rabbi, he who was with you beyond the Jordan, to whom you bore witness, here he is, baptizing, and all are going to him.”
verses.heading: Jesus and John the Baptist

verses.text: John answered, “No one can receive anything except what is given him from heaven.
verses.heading: Jesus and John the Baptist

verses.text: You yourselves bear me witness, that I said, I am not the Christ, but I have been sent before him.
verses.heading: Jesus and John the Baptist

verses.text: He who has the bride is the bridegroom; the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly at the bridegroom’s voice; therefore this joy of mine is now full.
verses.heading: Jesus and John the Baptist

verses.text: He must increase, but I must decrease.”
verses.heading: Jesus and John the Baptist

verses.text: He who comes from above is above all; he who is of the earth belongs to the earth, and of the earth he speaks; he who comes from heaven is above all.
verses.heading: He Who Comes from Heaven

verses.text: He bears witness to what he has seen and heard, yet no one receives his testimony;
verses.heading: He Who Comes from Heaven

verses.text: he who receives his testimony sets his seal to this, that God is true.
verses.heading: He Who Comes from Heaven

verses.text: For he whom God has sent utters the words of God, for it is not by measure that he gives the Spirit;
verses.heading: He Who Comes from Heaven

verses.text: the Father loves the Son, and has given all things into his hand.
verses.heading: He Who Comes from Heaven

verses.text: He who believes in the Son has eternal life; he who does not obey the Son shall not see life, but the wrath of God rests upon him.
verses.heading: He Who Comes from Heaven

headings.title: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Now when the Lord knew that the Pharisees had heard that Jesus was making and baptizing more disciples than John
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: (although Jesus himself did not baptize, but only his disciples),
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: he left Judea and departed again to Galilee.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: He had to pass through Samaria.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: So he came to a city of Samaria, called Sychar, near the field that Jacob gave to his son Joseph.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Jacob’s well was there, and so Jesus, wearied as he was with his journey, sat down beside the well. It was about the sixth hour.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: There came a woman of Samaria to draw water. Jesus said to her, “Give me a drink.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: For his disciples had gone away into the city to buy food.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: The Samaritan woman said to him, “How is it that you, a Jew, ask a drink of me, a woman of Samaria?” For Jews have no dealings with Samaritans.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God, and who it is that is saying to you, ‘Give me a drink,’ you would have asked him and he would have given you living water.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: The woman said to him, “Sir, you have nothing to draw with, and the well is deep; where do you get that living water?
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well, and drank from it himself, and his sons, and his cattle?”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Jesus said to her, “Every one who drinks of this water will thirst again,
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: but whoever drinks of the water that I shall give him will never thirst; the water that I shall give him will become in him a spring of water welling up to eternal life.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water, that I may not thirst, nor come here to draw.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Jesus said to her, “Go, call your husband, and come here.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: The woman answered him, “I have no husband.” Jesus said to her, “You are right in saying, ‘I have no husband’;
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: for you have had five husbands, and he whom you now have is not your husband; this you said truly.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: The woman said to him, “Sir, I perceive that you are a prophet.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Our fathers worshiped on this mountain; and you say that in Jerusalem is the place where men ought to worship.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Jesus said to her, “Woman, believe me, the hour is coming when neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem will you worship the Father.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: You worship what you do not know; we worship what we know, for salvation is from the Jews.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: But the hour is coming, and now is, when the true worshipers will worship the Father in spirit and truth, for such the Father seeks to worship him.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: God is spirit, and those who worship him must worship in spirit and truth.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: The woman said to him, “I know that Messiah is coming (he who is called Christ); when he comes, he will show us all things.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Jesus said to her, “I who speak to you am he.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Just then his disciples came. They marveled that he was talking with a woman, but none said, “What do you wish?” or, “Why are you talking with her?”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: So the woman left her water jar, and went away into the city, and said to the people,
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: “Come, see a man who told me all that I ever did. Can this be the Christ?”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: They went out of the city and were coming to him.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Meanwhile the disciples begged him, saying, “Rabbi, eat.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: But he said to them, “I have food to eat of which you do not know.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: So the disciples said to one another, “Has any one brought him food?”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “My food is to do the will of him who sent me, and to accomplish his work.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Do you not say, ‘There are yet four months, then comes the harvest’? I tell you, lift up your eyes, and see how the fields are already white for harvest.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: He who reaps receives wages, and gathers fruit for eternal life, so that sower and reaper may rejoice together.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: For here the saying holds true, ‘One sows and another reaps.’
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: I sent you to reap that for which you did not labor; others have labored, and you have entered into their labor.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: Many Samaritans from that city believed in him because of the woman’s testimony, “He told me all that I ever did.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: So when the Samaritans came to him, they asked him to stay with them; and he stayed there two days.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: And many more believed because of his word.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: They said to the woman, “It is no longer because of your words that we believe, for we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this is indeed the Savior of the world.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Woman of Samaria

verses.text: After the two days he departed to Galilee.
verses.heading: Jesus Departs for Galilee

verses.text: For Jesus himself testified that a prophet has no honor in his own country.
verses.heading: Jesus Departs for Galilee

verses.text: So when he came to Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him, having seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the feast, for they too had gone to the feast.
verses.heading: Jesus Departs for Galilee

verses.text: So he came again to Cana in Galilee, where he had made the water wine. And at Caperna-um there was an official whose son was ill.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals an Official’s Son

verses.text: When he heard that Jesus had come from Judea to Galilee, he went and begged him to come down and heal his son, for he was at the point of death.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals an Official’s Son

verses.text: Jesus therefore said to him, “Unless you see signs and wonders you will not believe.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals an Official’s Son

verses.text: The official said to him, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals an Official’s Son

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “Go; your son will live.” The man believed the word that Jesus spoke to him and went his way.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals an Official’s Son

verses.text: As he was going down, his servants met him and told him that his son was living.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals an Official’s Son

verses.text: So he asked them the hour when he began to mend, and they said to him, “Yesterday at the seventh hour the fever left him.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals an Official’s Son

verses.text: The father knew that was the hour when Jesus had said to him, “Your son will live”; and he himself believed, and all his household.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals an Official’s Son

verses.text: This was now the second sign that Jesus did when he had come from Judea to Galilee.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals an Official’s Son

verses.text: After this there was a feast of the Jews, and Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: Now there is in Jerusalem by the Sheep Gate a pool, in Hebrew called Beth-zatha, which has five porticoes.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: In these lay a multitude of invalids, blind, lame, paralyzed.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: One man was there, who had been ill for thirty-eight years.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: When Jesus saw him and knew that he had been lying there a long time, he said to him, “Do you want to be healed?”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: The sick man answered him, “Sir, I have no man to put me into the pool when the water is troubled, and while I am going another steps down before me.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “Rise, take up your pallet, and walk.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: And at once the man was healed, and he took up his pallet and walked. Now that day was the sabbath.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: So the Jews said to the man who was cured, “It is the sabbath, it is not lawful for you to carry your pallet.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: But he answered them, “The man who healed me said to me, ‘Take up your pallet, and walk.’”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: They asked him, “Who is the man who said to you, ‘Take up your pallet, and walk’?”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: Now the man who had been healed did not know who it was, for Jesus had withdrawn, as there was a crowd in the place.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: Afterward, Jesus found him in the temple, and said to him, “See, you are well! Sin no more, that nothing worse befall you.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: The man went away and told the Jews that it was Jesus who had healed him.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: And this was why the Jews persecuted Jesus, because he did this on the sabbath.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: But Jesus answered them, “My Father is working still, and I am working.”
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: This was why the Jews sought all the more to kill him, because he not only broke the sabbath but also called God his Father, making himself equal with God.
verses.heading: Jesus Heals on the Sabbath

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, the Son can do nothing of his own accord, but only what he sees the Father doing; for whatever he does, that the Son does likewise.
verses.heading: The Authority of the Son

verses.text: For the Father loves the Son, and shows him all that he himself is doing; and greater works than these will he show him, that you may marvel.
verses.heading: The Authority of the Son

verses.text: For as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, so also the Son gives life to whom he will.
verses.heading: The Authority of the Son

verses.text: The Father judges no one, but has given all judgment to the Son,
verses.heading: The Authority of the Son

verses.text: that all may honor the Son, even as they honor the Father. He who does not honor the Son does not honor the Father who sent him.
verses.heading: The Authority of the Son

verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, he who hears my word and believes him who sent me, has eternal life; he does not come into judgment, but has passed from death to life.
verses.heading: The Authority of the Son

verses.text: “Truly, truly, I say to you, the hour is coming, and now is, when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God, and those who hear will live.
verses.heading: The Authority of the Son

verses.text: For as the Father has life in himself, so he has granted the Son also to have life in himself,
verses.heading: The Authority of the Son

verses.text: and has given him authority to execute judgment, because he is the Son of man.
verses.heading: The Authority of the Son

verses.text: Do not marvel at this; for the hour is coming when all who are in the tombs will hear his voice
verses.heading: The Authority of the Son

verses.text: and come forth, those who have done good, to the resurrection of life, and those who have done evil, to the resurrection of judgment.
verses.heading: The Authority of the Son

verses.text: “I can do nothing on my own authority; as I hear, I judge; and my judgment is just, because I seek not my own will but the will of him who sent me.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: If I bear witness to myself, my testimony is not true;
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: there is another who bears witness to me, and I know that the testimony which he bears to me is true.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: You sent to John, and he has borne witness to the truth.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: Not that the testimony which I receive is from man; but I say this that you may be saved.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: He was a burning and shining lamp, and you were willing to rejoice for a while in his light.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: But the testimony which I have is greater than that of John; for the works which the Father has granted me to accomplish, these very works which I am doing, bear me witness that the Father has sent me.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: And the Father who sent me has himself borne witness to me. His voice you have never heard, his form you have never seen;
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: and you do not have his word abiding in you, for you do not believe him whom he has sent.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: You search the Scriptures, because you think that in them you have eternal life; and it is they that bear witness to me;
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: yet you refuse to come to me that you may have life.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: I do not receive glory from men.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: But I know that you have not the love of God within you.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: I have come in my Father’s name, and you do not receive me; if another comes in his own name, him you will receive.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: How can you believe, who receive glory from one another and do not seek the glory that comes from the only God?
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: Do not think that I shall accuse you to the Father; it is Moses who accuses you, on whom you set your hope.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: If you believed Moses, you would believe me, for he wrote of me.
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: But if you do not believe his writings, how will you believe my words?”
verses.heading: The Testimony to Jesus

verses.text: After this Jesus went to the other side of the Sea of Galilee, which is the Sea of Tiberi-as.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: And a multitude followed him, because they saw the signs which he did on those who were diseased.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: Jesus went up into the hills, and there sat down with his disciples.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: Now the Passover, the feast of the Jews, was at hand.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: Lifting up his eyes, then, and seeing that a multitude was coming to him, Jesus said to Philip, “How are we to buy bread, so that these people may eat?”
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: This he said to test him, for he himself knew what he would do.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: Philip answered him, “Two hundred denarii would not buy enough bread for each of them to get a little.”
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: One of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peter’s brother, said to him,
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: “There is a lad here who has five barley loaves and two fish; but what are they among so many?”
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: Jesus said, “Make the people sit down.” Now there was much grass in the place; so the men sat down, in number about five thousand.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: Jesus then took the loaves, and when he had given thanks, he distributed them to those who were seated; so also the fish, as much as they wanted.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: And when they had eaten their fill, he told his disciples, “Gather up the fragments left over, that nothing may be lost.”
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: So they gathered them up and filled twelve baskets with fragments from the five barley loaves, left by those who had eaten.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: When the people saw the sign which he had done, they said, “This is indeed the prophet who is to come into the world!”
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: Perceiving then that they were about to come and take him by force to make him king, Jesus withdrew again to the hills by himself.
verses.heading: Feeding the Five Thousand

verses.text: When evening came, his disciples went down to the sea,
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: got into a boat, and started across the sea to Caperna-um. It was now dark, and Jesus had not yet come to them.
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: The sea rose because a strong wind was blowing.
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus walking on the sea and drawing near to the boat. They were frightened,
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: but he said to them, “It is I; do not be afraid.”
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: Then they were glad to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat was at the land to which they were going.
verses.heading: Jesus Walks on the Sea

verses.text: On the next day the people who remained on the other side of the sea saw that there had been only one boat there, and that Jesus had not entered the boat with his disciples, but that his disciples had gone away alone.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: However, boats from Tiberi-as came near the place where they ate the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: So when the people saw that Jesus was not there, nor his disciples, they themselves got into the boats and went to Caperna-um, seeking Jesus.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: When they found him on the other side of the sea, they said to him, “Rabbi, when did you come here?”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, you seek me, not because you saw signs, but because you ate your fill of the loaves.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: Do not labor for the food which perishes, but for the food which endures to eternal life, which the Son of man will give to you; for on him has God the Father set his seal.”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: Then they said to him, “What must we do, to be doing the works of God?”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “This is the work of God, that you believe in him whom he has sent.”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: So they said to him, “Then what sign do you do, that we may see, and believe you? What work do you perform?
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: Our fathers ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written, ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: Jesus then said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, it was not Moses who gave you the bread from heaven; my Father gives you the true bread from heaven.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: For the bread of God is that which comes down from heaven, and gives life to the world.”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: They said to him, “Lord, give us this bread always.”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “I am the bread of life; he who comes to me shall not hunger, and he who believes in me shall never thirst.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: But I said to you that you have seen me and yet do not believe.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: All that the Father gives me will come to me; and him who comes to me I will not cast out.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: For I have come down from heaven, not to do my own will, but the will of him who sent me;
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: and this is the will of him who sent me, that I should lose nothing of all that he has given me, but raise it up at the last day.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: For this is the will of my Father, that every one who sees the Son and believes in him should have eternal life; and I will raise him up at the last day.”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: The Jews then murmured at him, because he said, “I am the bread which came down from heaven.”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: They said, “Is not this Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How does he now say, ‘I have come down from heaven’?”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “Do not murmur among yourselves.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws him; and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: It is written in the prophets, ‘And they shall all be taught by God.’ Every one who has heard and learned from the Father comes to me.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: Not that any one has seen the Father except him who is from God; he has seen the Father.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, he who believes has eternal life.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: I am the bread of life.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: Your fathers ate the manna in the wilderness, and they died.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: This is the bread which comes down from heaven, that a man may eat of it and not die.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: I am the living bread which came down from heaven; if any one eats of this bread, he will live for ever; and the bread which I shall give for the life of the world is my flesh.”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: The Jews then disputed among themselves, saying, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: So Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of man and drink his blood, you have no life in you;
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: he who eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise him up at the last day.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: For my flesh is food indeed, and my blood is drink indeed.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: He who eats my flesh and drinks my blood abides in me, and I in him.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: As the living Father sent me, and I live because of the Father, so he who eats me will live because of me.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: This is the bread which came down from heaven, not such as the fathers ate and died; he who eats this bread will live for ever.”
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: This he said in the synagogue, as he taught at Caperna-um.
verses.heading: The Bread from Heaven

verses.text: Many of his disciples, when they heard it, said, “This is a hard saying; who can listen to it?”
verses.heading: The Words of Eternal Life

verses.text: But Jesus, knowing in himself that his disciples murmured at it, said to them, “Do you take offense at this?
verses.heading: The Words of Eternal Life

verses.text: Then what if you were to see the Son of man ascending where he was before?
verses.heading: The Words of Eternal Life

verses.text: It is the Spirit that gives life, the flesh is of no avail; the words that I have spoken to you are Spirit and life.
verses.heading: The Words of Eternal Life

verses.text: But there are some of you that do not believe.” For Jesus knew from the first who those were that did not believe, and who it was that would betray him.
verses.heading: The Words of Eternal Life

verses.text: And he said, “This is why I told you that no one can come to me unless it is granted him by the Father.”
verses.heading: The Words of Eternal Life

verses.text: After this many of his disciples drew back and no longer walked with him.
verses.heading: The Words of Eternal Life

verses.text: Jesus said to the Twelve, “Will you also go away?”
verses.heading: The Words of Eternal Life

verses.text: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life;
verses.heading: The Words of Eternal Life

verses.text: and we have believed, and have come to know, that you are the Holy One of God.”
verses.heading: The Words of Eternal Life

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “Did I not choose you, the Twelve, and one of you is a devil?”
verses.heading: The Words of Eternal Life

verses.text: He spoke of Judas the son of Simon Iscariot, for he, one of the Twelve, was to betray him.
verses.heading: The Words of Eternal Life

headings.title: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles
Officers Are Sent to Arrest Jesus
The Authorities and the Woman Caught in Adultery

verses.text: After this Jesus went about in Galilee; he would not go about in Judea, because the Jews sought to kill him.
verses.heading: The Unbelief of Jesus’ Brethren

verses.text: Now the Jews’ feast of Tabernacles was at hand.
verses.heading: The Unbelief of Jesus’ Brethren

verses.text: So his brethren said to him, “Leave here and go to Judea, that your disciples may see the works you are doing.
verses.heading: The Unbelief of Jesus’ Brethren

verses.text: For no man works in secret if he seeks to be known openly. If you do these things, show yourself to the world.”
verses.heading: The Unbelief of Jesus’ Brethren

verses.text: For even his brethren did not believe in him.
verses.heading: The Unbelief of Jesus’ Brethren

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “My time has not yet come, but your time is always here.
verses.heading: The Unbelief of Jesus’ Brethren

verses.text: The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify of it that its works are evil.
verses.heading: The Unbelief of Jesus’ Brethren

verses.text: Go to the feast yourselves; I am not going up to this feast, for my time has not yet fully come.”
verses.heading: The Unbelief of Jesus’ Brethren

verses.text: So saying, he remained in Galilee.
verses.heading: The Unbelief of Jesus’ Brethren

verses.text: But after his brethren had gone up to the feast, then he also went up, not publicly but in private.
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: The Jews were looking for him at the feast, and saying, “Where is he?”
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: And there was much muttering about him among the people. While some said, “He is a good man,” others said, “No, he is leading the people astray.”
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: Yet for fear of the Jews no one spoke openly of him.
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: About the middle of the feast Jesus went up into the temple and taught.
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: The Jews marveled at it, saying, “How is it that this man has learning, when he has never studied?”
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: So Jesus answered them, “My teaching is not mine, but his who sent me;
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: if any man’s will is to do his will, he shall know whether the teaching is from God or whether I am speaking on my own authority.
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: He who speaks on his own authority seeks his own glory; but he who seeks the glory of him who sent him is true, and in him there is no falsehood.
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: Did not Moses give you the law? Yet none of you keeps the law. Why do you seek to kill me?”
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: The people answered, “You have a demon! Who is seeking to kill you?”
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “I did one deed, and you all marvel at it.
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: Moses gave you circumcision (not that it is from Moses, but from the fathers), and you circumcise a man upon the sabbath.
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: If on the sabbath a man receives circumcision, so that the law of Moses may not be broken, are you angry with me because on the sabbath I made a man’s whole body well?
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: Do not judge by appearances, but judge with right judgment.”
verses.heading: Jesus at the Feast of Tabernacles

verses.text: Some of the people of Jerusalem therefore said, “Is not this the man whom they seek to kill?
verses.heading: Is This the Christ?

verses.text: And here he is, speaking openly, and they say nothing to him! Can it be that the authorities really know that this is the Christ?
verses.heading: Is This the Christ?

verses.text: Yet we know where this man comes from; and when the Christ appears, no one will know where he comes from.”
verses.heading: Is This the Christ?

verses.text: So Jesus proclaimed, as he taught in the temple, “You know me, and you know where I come from? But I have not come of my own accord; he who sent me is true, and him you do not know.
verses.heading: Is This the Christ?

verses.text: I know him, for I come from him, and he sent me.”
verses.heading: Is This the Christ?

verses.text: So they sought to arrest him; but no one laid hands on him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.heading: Is This the Christ?

verses.text: Yet many of the people believed in him; they said, “When the Christ appears, will he do more signs than this man has done?”
verses.heading: Is This the Christ?

verses.text: The Pharisees heard the crowd thus muttering about him, and the chief priests and Pharisees sent officers to arrest him.
verses.heading: Officers Are Sent to Arrest Jesus

verses.text: Jesus then said, “I shall be with you a little longer, and then I go to him who sent me;
verses.heading: Officers Are Sent to Arrest Jesus

verses.text: you will seek me and you will not find me; where I am you cannot come.”
verses.heading: Officers Are Sent to Arrest Jesus

verses.text: The Jews said to one another, “Where does this man intend to go that we shall not find him? Does he intend to go to the Dispersion among the Greeks and teach the Greeks?
verses.heading: Officers Are Sent to Arrest Jesus

verses.text: What does he mean by saying, ‘You will seek me and you will not find me,’ and, ‘Where I am you cannot come’?”
verses.heading: Officers Are Sent to Arrest Jesus

verses.text: On the last day of the feast, the great day, Jesus stood up and proclaimed, “If any one thirst, let him come to me and drink.
verses.heading: Rivers of Living Water

verses.text: He who believes in me, as the Scripture has said, ‘Out of his heart shall flow rivers of living water.’”
verses.heading: Rivers of Living Water

verses.text: Now this he said about the Spirit, which those who believed in him were to receive; for as yet the Spirit had not been given, because Jesus was not yet glorified.
verses.heading: Rivers of Living Water

verses.text: When they heard these words, some of the people said, “This is really the prophet.”
verses.heading: Division among the People

verses.text: Others said, “This is the Christ.” But some said, “Is the Christ to come from Galilee?
verses.heading: Division among the People

verses.text: Has not the Scripture said that the Christ is descended from David, and comes from Bethlehem, the village where David was?”
verses.heading: Division among the People

verses.text: So there was a division among the people over him.
verses.heading: Division among the People

verses.text: Some of them wanted to arrest him, but no one laid hands on him.
verses.heading: Division among the People

verses.text: The officers then went back to the chief priests and Pharisees, who said to them, “Why did you not bring him?”
verses.heading: The Authorities and the Woman Caught in Adultery

verses.text: The officers answered, “No man ever spoke like this man!”
verses.heading: The Authorities and the Woman Caught in Adultery

verses.text: The Pharisees answered them, “Are you led astray, you also?
verses.heading: The Authorities and the Woman Caught in Adultery

verses.text: Have any of the authorities or of the Pharisees believed in him?
verses.heading: The Authorities and the Woman Caught in Adultery

verses.text: But this crowd, who do not know the law, are accursed.”
verses.heading: The Authorities and the Woman Caught in Adultery

verses.text: Nicodemus, who had gone to him before, and who was one of them, said to them,
verses.heading: The Authorities and the Woman Caught in Adultery

verses.text: “Does our law judge a man without first giving him a hearing and learning what he does?”
verses.heading: The Authorities and the Woman Caught in Adultery

verses.text: They replied, “Are you from Galilee too? Search and you will see that no prophet is to rise from Galilee.”
verses.heading: The Authorities and the Woman Caught in Adultery

verses.text: They went each to his own house,
verses.heading: The Authorities and the Woman Caught in Adultery

headings.title: Jesus and the Light of the World

verses.text: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
Early in the morning he came again to the temple; all the people came to him, and he sat down and taught them.
The scribes and the Pharisees brought a woman who had been caught in adultery, and placing her in their midst
they said to him, “Teacher, this woman has been caught in the act of adultery.
Now in the law Moses commanded us to stone such. What do you say about her?”
This they said to test him, that they might have some charge to bring against him. Jesus bent down and wrote with his finger on the ground.
And as they continued to ask him, he stood up and said to them, “Let him who is without sin among you be the first to throw a stone at her.”
And once more he bent down and wrote with his finger on the ground.
But when they heard it, they went away, one by one, beginning with the eldest, and Jesus was left alone with the woman standing before him.
Jesus looked up and said to her, “Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?”
She said, “No one, Lord.” And Jesus said, “Neither do I condemn you; go, and do not sin again.”
Again Jesus spoke to them, saying, “I am the light of the world; he who follows me will not walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Light of the World

verses.text: The Pharisees then said to him, “You are bearing witness to yourself; your testimony is not true.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Light of the World

verses.text: Jesus answered, “Even if I do bear witness to myself, my testimony is true, for I know where I have come from and where I am going, but you do not know where I come from or where I am going.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Light of the World

verses.text: You judge according to the flesh, I judge no one.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Light of the World

verses.text: Yet even if I do judge, my judgment is true, for it is not I alone that judge, but I and he who sent me.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Light of the World

verses.text: In your law it is written that the testimony of two men is true;
verses.heading: Jesus and the Light of the World

verses.text: I bear witness to myself, and the Father who sent me bears witness to me.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Light of the World

verses.text: They said to him therefore, “Where is your Father?” Jesus answered, “You know neither me nor my Father; if you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Light of the World

verses.text: These words he spoke in the treasury, as he taught in the temple; but no one arrested him, because his hour had not yet come.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Light of the World

verses.text: Again he said to them, “I go away, and you will seek me and die in your sin; where I am going, you cannot come.”
verses.heading: Jesus Alludes to His Death

verses.text: Then said the Jews, “Will he kill himself, since he says, ‘Where I am going, you cannot come’?”
verses.heading: Jesus Alludes to His Death

verses.text: He said to them, “You are from below, I am from above; you are of this world, I am not of this world.
verses.heading: Jesus Alludes to His Death

verses.text: I told you that you would die in your sins, for you will die in your sins unless you believe that I am he.”
verses.heading: Jesus Alludes to His Death

verses.text: They said to him, “Who are you?” Jesus said to them, “Even what I have told you from the beginning.
verses.heading: Jesus Alludes to His Death

verses.text: I have much to say about you and much to judge; but he who sent me is true, and I declare to the world what I have heard from him.”
verses.heading: Jesus Alludes to His Death

verses.text: They did not understand that he spoke to them of the Father.
verses.heading: Jesus Alludes to His Death

verses.text: So Jesus said, “When you have lifted up the Son of man, then you will know that I am he, and that I do nothing on my own authority but speak thus as the Father taught me.
verses.heading: Jesus Alludes to His Death

verses.text: And he who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, for I always do what is pleasing to him.”
verses.heading: Jesus Alludes to His Death

verses.text: As he spoke thus, many believed in him.
verses.heading: Jesus Alludes to His Death

verses.text: Jesus then said to the Jews who had believed in him, “If you continue in my word, you are truly my disciples,
verses.heading: True Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: and you will know the truth, and the truth will make you free.”
verses.heading: True Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: They answered him, “We are descendants of Abraham, and have never been in bondage to any one. How is it that you say, ‘You will be made free’?”
verses.heading: True Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, every one who commits sin is a slave to sin.
verses.heading: True Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: The slave does not continue in the house for ever; the son continues for ever.
verses.heading: True Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: So if the Son makes you free, you will be free indeed.
verses.heading: True Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: I know that you are descendants of Abraham; yet you seek to kill me, because my word finds no place in you.
verses.heading: True Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: I speak of what I have seen with my Father, and you do what you have heard from your father.”
verses.heading: True Disciples of Jesus

verses.text: They answered him, “Abraham is our father.” Jesus said to them, “If you were Abraham’s children, you would do what Abraham did,
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: but now you seek to kill me, a man who has told you the truth which I heard from God; this is not what Abraham did.
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: You do the works of your father.” They said to him, “We were not born of fornication; we have one Father, even God.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love me, for I proceeded and came forth from God; I came not of my own accord, but he sent me.
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: Why do you not understand what I say? It is because you cannot bear to hear my word.
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: You are of your father the devil, and your will is to do your father’s desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, and has nothing to do with the truth, because there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks according to his own nature, for he is a liar and the father of lies.
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: But, because I tell the truth, you do not believe me.
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: Which of you convicts me of sin? If I tell the truth, why do you not believe me?
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: He who is of God hears the words of God; the reason why you do not hear them is that you are not of God.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: The Jews answered him, “Are we not right in saying that you are a Samaritan and have a demon?”
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: Jesus answered, “I have not a demon; but I honor my Father, and you dishonor me.
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: Yet I do not seek my own glory; there is One who seeks it and he will be the judge.
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, if any one keeps my word, he will never see death.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: The Jews said to him, “Now we know that you have a demon. Abraham died, as did the prophets; and you say, ‘If any one keeps my word, he will never taste death.’
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: Are you greater than our father Abraham, who died? And the prophets died! Who do you claim to be?”
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: Jesus answered, “If I glorify myself, my glory is nothing; it is my Father who glorifies me, of whom you say that he is your God.
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: But you have not known him; I know him. If I said, I do not know him, I should be a liar like you; but I do know him and I keep his word.
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: Your father Abraham rejoiced that he was to see my day; he saw it and was glad.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: The Jews then said to him, “You are not yet fifty years old, and have you seen Abraham?”
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, before Abraham was, I am.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: So they took up stones to throw at him; but Jesus hid himself, and went out of the temple.
verses.heading: Jesus and Abraham

verses.text: As he passed by, he saw a man blind from his birth.
verses.heading: Healing of the Blind Man

verses.text: And his disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
verses.heading: Healing of the Blind Man

verses.text: Jesus answered, “It was not that this man sinned, or his parents, but that the works of God might be made manifest in him.
verses.heading: Healing of the Blind Man

verses.text: We must work the works of him who sent me, while it is day; night comes, when no one can work.
verses.heading: Healing of the Blind Man

verses.text: As long as I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
verses.heading: Healing of the Blind Man

verses.text: As he said this, he spat on the ground and made clay of the spittle and anointed the man’s eyes with the clay,
verses.heading: Healing of the Blind Man

verses.text: saying to him, “Go, wash in the pool of Siloam” (which means Sent). So he went and washed and came back seeing.
verses.heading: Healing of the Blind Man

verses.text: The neighbors and those who had seen him before as a beggar, said, “Is not this the man who used to sit and beg?”
verses.heading: Healing of the Blind Man

verses.text: Some said, “It is he”; others said, “No, but he is like him.” He said, “I am the man.”
verses.heading: Healing of the Blind Man

verses.text: They said to him, “Then how were your eyes opened?”
verses.heading: Healing of the Blind Man

verses.text: He answered, “The man called Jesus made clay and anointed my eyes and said to me, ‘Go to Siloam and wash’; so I went and washed and received my sight.”
verses.heading: Healing of the Blind Man

verses.text: They said to him, “Where is he?” He said, “I do not know.”
verses.heading: Healing of the Blind Man

verses.text: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had formerly been blind.
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: Now it was a sabbath day when Jesus made the clay and opened his eyes.
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: The Pharisees again asked him how he had received his sight. And he said to them, “He put clay on my eyes, and I washed, and I see.”
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, for he does not keep the sabbath.” But others said, “How can a man who is a sinner do such signs?” There was a division among them.
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: So they again said to the blind man, “What do you say about him, since he has opened your eyes?” He said, “He is a prophet.”
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: The Jews did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight, until they called the parents of the man who had received his sight,
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: and asked them, “Is this your son, who you say was born blind? How then does he now see?”
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: His parents answered, “We know that this is our son, and that he was born blind;
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: but how he now sees we do not know, nor do we know who opened his eyes. Ask him; he is of age, he will speak for himself.”
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: His parents said this because they feared the Jews, for the Jews had already agreed that if any one should confess him to be Christ, he was to be put out of the synagogue.
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: Therefore his parents said, “He is of age, ask him.”
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: So for the second time they called the man who had been blind, and said to him, “Give God the praise; we know that this man is a sinner.”
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: He answered, “Whether he is a sinner, I do not know; one thing I know, that though I was blind, now I see.”
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: They said to him, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: He answered them, “I have told you already, and you would not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you too want to become his disciples?”
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: And they reviled him, saying, “You are his disciple, but we are disciples of Moses.
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: We know that God has spoken to Moses, but as for this man, we do not know where he comes from.”
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: The man answered, “Why, this is a marvel! You do not know where he comes from, and yet he opened my eyes.
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: We know that God does not listen to sinners, but if any one is a worshiper of God and does his will, God listens to him.
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: Never since the world began has it been heard that any one opened the eyes of a man born blind.
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: They answered him, “You were born in utter sin, and would you teach us?” And they cast him out.
verses.heading: The Pharisees Investigate the Healing

verses.text: Jesus heard that they had cast him out, and having found him he said, “Do you believe in the Son of man?”
verses.heading: Spiritual Blindness

verses.text: He answered, “And who is he, sir, that I may believe in him?”
verses.heading: Spiritual Blindness

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “You have seen him, and it is he who speaks to you.”
verses.heading: Spiritual Blindness

verses.text: He said, “Lord, I believe”; and he worshiped him.
verses.heading: Spiritual Blindness

verses.text: Jesus said, “For judgment I came into this world, that those who do not see may see, and that those who see may become blind.”
verses.heading: Spiritual Blindness

verses.text: Some of the Pharisees near him heard this, and they said to him, “Are we also blind?”
verses.heading: Spiritual Blindness

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “If you were blind, you would have no guilt; but now that you say, ‘We see,’ your guilt remains.
verses.heading: Spiritual Blindness

headings.title: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: “Truly, truly, I say to you, he who does not enter the sheepfold by the door but climbs in by another way, that man is a thief and a robber;
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: but he who enters by the door is the shepherd of the sheep.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: To him the gatekeeper opens; the sheep hear his voice, and he calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: When he has brought out all his own, he goes before them, and the sheep follow him, for they know his voice.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: A stranger they will not follow, but they will flee from him, for they do not know the voice of strangers.”
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: This figure Jesus used with them, but they did not understand what he was saying to them.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: So Jesus again said to them, “Truly, truly, I say to you, I am the door of the sheep.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: All who came before me are thieves and robbers; but the sheep did not heed them.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: I am the door; if any one enters by me, he will be saved, and will go in and out and find pasture.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I came that they may have life, and have it abundantly.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: He who is a hireling and not a shepherd, whose own the sheep are not, sees the wolf coming and leaves the sheep and flees; and the wolf snatches them and scatters them.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: He flees because he is a hireling and cares nothing for the sheep.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: I am the good shepherd; I know my own and my own know me,
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: as the Father knows me and I know the Father; and I lay down my life for the sheep.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: And I have other sheep, that are not of this fold; I must bring them also, and they will heed my voice. So there shall be one flock, one shepherd.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: For this reason the Father loves me, because I lay down my life, that I may take it again.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have power to lay it down, and I have power to take it again; this charge I have received from my Father.”
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: There was again a division among the Jews because of these words.
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: Many of them said, “He has a demon, and he is mad; why listen to him?”
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: Others said, “These are not the sayings of one who has a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?”
verses.heading: Jesus the Good Shepherd

verses.text: It was the feast of the Dedication at Jerusalem;
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: it was winter, and Jesus was walking in the temple, in the portico of Solomon.
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: So the Jews gathered round him and said to him, “How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Christ, tell us plainly.”
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “I told you, and you do not believe. The works that I do in my Father’s name, they bear witness to me;
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: but you do not believe, because you do not belong to my sheep.
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me;
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: and I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish, and no one shall snatch them out of my hand.
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all, and no one is able to snatch them out of the Father’s hand.
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: I and the Father are one.”
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: The Jews took up stones again to stone him.
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “I have shown you many good works from the Father; for which of these do you stone me?”
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: The Jews answered him, “We stone you for no good work but for blasphemy; because you, being a man, make yourself God.”
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “Is it not written in your law, ‘I said, you are gods’?
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: If he called them gods to whom the word of God came (and Scripture cannot be nullified),
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: do you say of him whom the Father consecrated and sent into the world, ‘You are blaspheming,’ because I said, ‘I am the Son of God’?
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: If I am not doing the works of my Father, then do not believe me;
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: but if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me and I am in the Father.”
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: Again they tried to arrest him, but he escaped from their hands.
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: He went away again across the Jordan to the place where John at first baptized, and there he remained.
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: And many came to him; and they said, “John did no sign, but everything that John said about this man was true.”
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

verses.text: And many believed in him there.
verses.heading: Jesus Is Rejected by the Jews

headings.title: Jesus the Resurrection and the Life
The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: Now a certain man was ill, Lazarus of Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: It was Mary who anointed the Lord with ointment and wiped his feet with her hair, whose brother Lazarus was ill.
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: So the sisters sent to him, saying, “Lord, he whom you love is ill.”
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: But when Jesus heard it he said, “This illness is not unto death; it is for the glory of God, so that the Son of God may be glorified by means of it.”
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: So when he heard that he was ill, he stayed two days longer in the place where he was.
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: Then after this he said to the disciples, “Let us go into Judea again.”
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: The disciples said to him, “Rabbi, the Jews were but now seeking to stone you, and are you going there again?”
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours in the day? If any one walks in the day, he does not stumble, because he sees the light of this world.
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: But if any one walks in the night, he stumbles, because the light is not in him.”
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: Thus he spoke, and then he said to them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep, but I go to awake him out of sleep.”
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: The disciples said to him, “Lord, if he has fallen asleep, he will recover.”
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: Now Jesus had spoken of his death, but they thought that he meant taking rest in sleep.
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: Then Jesus told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead;
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: and for your sake I am glad that I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: Thomas, called the Twin, said to his fellow disciples, “Let us also go, that we may die with him.”
verses.heading: The Death of Lazarus

verses.text: Now when Jesus came, he found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb four days.
verses.heading: Jesus the Resurrection and the Life

verses.text: Bethany was near Jerusalem, about two miles off,
verses.heading: Jesus the Resurrection and the Life

verses.text: and many of the Jews had come to Martha and Mary to console them concerning their brother.
verses.heading: Jesus the Resurrection and the Life

verses.text: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went and met him, while Mary sat in the house.
verses.heading: Jesus the Resurrection and the Life

verses.text: Martha said to Jesus, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
verses.heading: Jesus the Resurrection and the Life

verses.text: And even now I know that whatever you ask from God, God will give you.”
verses.heading: Jesus the Resurrection and the Life

verses.text: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
verses.heading: Jesus the Resurrection and the Life

verses.text: Martha said to him, “I know that he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
verses.heading: Jesus the Resurrection and the Life

verses.text: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life; he who believes in me, though he die, yet shall he live,
verses.heading: Jesus the Resurrection and the Life

verses.text: and whoever lives and believes in me shall never die. Do you believe this?”
verses.heading: Jesus the Resurrection and the Life

verses.text: She said to him, “Yes, Lord; I believe that you are the Christ, the Son of God, he who is coming into the world.”
verses.heading: Jesus the Resurrection and the Life

verses.text: When she had said this, she went and called her sister Mary, saying quietly, “The Teacher is here and is calling for you.”
verses.heading: Jesus Weeps

verses.text: And when she heard it, she rose quickly and went to him.
verses.heading: Jesus Weeps

verses.text: Now Jesus had not yet come to the village, but was still in the place where Martha had met him.
verses.heading: Jesus Weeps

verses.text: When the Jews who were with her in the house, consoling her, saw Mary rise quickly and go out, they followed her, supposing that she was going to the tomb to weep there.
verses.heading: Jesus Weeps

verses.text: Then Mary, when she came where Jesus was and saw him, fell at his feet, saying to him, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
verses.heading: Jesus Weeps

verses.text: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who came with her also weeping, he was deeply moved in spirit and troubled;
verses.heading: Jesus Weeps

verses.text: and he said, “Where have you laid him?” They said to him, “Lord, come and see.”
verses.heading: Jesus Weeps

verses.text: Jesus wept.
verses.heading: Jesus Weeps

verses.text: So the Jews said, “See how he loved him!”
verses.heading: Jesus Weeps
