verses.text: But some of them said, “Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying?”
verses.heading: Jesus Weeps

verses.text: Then Jesus, deeply moved again, came to the tomb; it was a cave, and a stone lay upon it.
verses.heading: Jesus Raises Lazarus to Life

verses.text: Jesus said, “Take away the stone.” Martha, the sister of the dead man, said to him, “Lord, by this time there will be an odor, for he has been dead four days.”
verses.heading: Jesus Raises Lazarus to Life

verses.text: Jesus said to her, “Did I not tell you that if you would believe you would see the glory of God?”
verses.heading: Jesus Raises Lazarus to Life

verses.text: So they took away the stone. And Jesus lifted up his eyes and said, “Father, I thank you that you have heard me.
verses.heading: Jesus Raises Lazarus to Life

verses.text: I knew that you always hear me, but I have said this on account of the people standing by, that they may believe that you sent me.”
verses.heading: Jesus Raises Lazarus to Life

verses.text: When he had said this, he cried with a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out.”
verses.heading: Jesus Raises Lazarus to Life

verses.text: The dead man came out, his hands and feet bound with bandages, and his face wrapped with a cloth. Jesus said to them, “Unbind him, and let him go.”
verses.heading: Jesus Raises Lazarus to Life

verses.text: Many of the Jews therefore, who had come with Mary and had seen what he did, believed in him;
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: but some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: So the chief priests and the Pharisees gathered the council, and said, “What are we to do? For this man performs many signs.
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: If we let him go on like this, every one will believe in him, and the Romans will come and destroy both our holy place and our nation.”
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: But one of them, Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, said to them, “You know nothing at all;
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: you do not understand that it is expedient for you that one man should die for the people, and that the whole nation should not perish.”
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: He did not say this of his own accord, but being high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus should die for the nation,
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: and not for the nation only, but to gather into one the children of God who are scattered abroad.
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: So from that day on they took counsel about how to put him to death.
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: Jesus therefore no longer went about openly among the Jews, but went from there to the country near the wilderness, to a town called Ephraim; and there he stayed with the disciples.
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: Now the Passover of the Jews was at hand, and many went up from the country to Jerusalem before the Passover, to purify themselves.
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: They were looking for Jesus and saying to one another as they stood in the temple, “What do you think? That he will not come to the feast?”
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

verses.text: Now the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that if any one knew where he was, he should let them know, so that they might arrest him.
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Jesus to Death

headings.title: The Plot to Put Lazarus to Death
Some Greeks Wish to See Jesus

verses.text: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.
verses.heading: Mary of Bethany Anoints Jesus

verses.text: There they made him a supper; Martha served, and Lazarus was one of those at table with him.
verses.heading: Mary of Bethany Anoints Jesus

verses.text: Mary took a pound of costly ointment of pure nard and anointed the feet of Jesus and wiped his feet with her hair; and the house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
verses.heading: Mary of Bethany Anoints Jesus

verses.text: But Judas Iscariot, one of his disciples (he who was to betray him), said,
verses.heading: Mary of Bethany Anoints Jesus

verses.text: “Why was this ointment not sold for three hundred denarii and given to the poor?”
verses.heading: Mary of Bethany Anoints Jesus

verses.text: This he said, not that he cared for the poor but because he was a thief, and as he had the money box he used to take what was put into it.
verses.heading: Mary of Bethany Anoints Jesus

verses.text: Jesus said, “Let her alone, let her keep it for the day of my burial.
verses.heading: Mary of Bethany Anoints Jesus

verses.text: The poor you always have with you, but you do not always have me.”
verses.heading: Mary of Bethany Anoints Jesus

verses.text: When the great crowd of the Jews learned that he was there, they came, not only on account of Jesus but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Lazarus to Death

verses.text: So the chief priests planned to put Lazarus also to death,
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Lazarus to Death

verses.text: because on account of him many of the Jews were going away and believing in Jesus.
verses.heading: The Plot to Put Lazarus to Death

verses.text: The next day a great crowd who had come to the feast heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Triumphal Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: So they took branches of palm trees and went out to meet him, crying, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, even the King of Israel!”
verses.heading: Jesus’ Triumphal Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: And Jesus found a young donkey and sat upon it; as it is written,
verses.heading: Jesus’ Triumphal Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: “Fear not, daughter of Zion; behold, your king is coming, sitting on a donkey’s colt!”
verses.heading: Jesus’ Triumphal Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: His disciples did not understand this at first; but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that this had been written of him and had been done to him.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Triumphal Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: The crowd that had been with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb and raised him from the dead bore witness.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Triumphal Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: The reason why the crowd went to meet him was that they heard he had done this sign.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Triumphal Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: The Pharisees then said to one another, “You see that you can do nothing; look, the world has gone after him.”
verses.heading: Jesus’ Triumphal Entry into Jerusalem

verses.text: Now among those who went up to worship at the feast were some Greeks.
verses.heading: Some Greeks Wish to See Jesus

verses.text: So these came to Philip, who was from Beth-saida in Galilee, and said to him, “Sir, we wish to see Jesus.”
verses.heading: Some Greeks Wish to See Jesus

verses.text: Philip went and told Andrew; Andrew went with Philip and they told Jesus.
verses.heading: Some Greeks Wish to See Jesus

verses.text: And Jesus answered them, “The hour has come for the Son of man to be glorified.
verses.heading: Some Greeks Wish to See Jesus

verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains alone; but if it dies, it bears much fruit.
verses.heading: Some Greeks Wish to See Jesus

verses.text: He who loves his life loses it, and he who hates his life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
verses.heading: Some Greeks Wish to See Jesus

verses.text: If any one serves me, he must follow me; and where I am, there shall my servant be also; if any one serves me, the Father will honor him.
verses.heading: Some Greeks Wish to See Jesus

verses.text: “Now is my soul troubled. And what shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this hour’? No, for this purpose I have come to this hour.
verses.heading: Jesus Speaks about His Death

verses.text: Father, glorify your name.” Then a voice came from heaven, “I have glorified it, and I will glorify it again.”
verses.heading: Jesus Speaks about His Death

verses.text: The crowd standing by heard it and said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
verses.heading: Jesus Speaks about His Death

verses.text: Jesus answered, “This voice has come for your sake, not for mine.
verses.heading: Jesus Speaks about His Death

verses.text: Now is the judgment of this world, now shall the ruler of this world be cast out;
verses.heading: Jesus Speaks about His Death

verses.text: and I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all men to myself.”
verses.heading: Jesus Speaks about His Death

verses.text: He said this to show by what death he was to die.
verses.heading: Jesus Speaks about His Death

verses.text: The crowd answered him, “We have heard from the law that the Christ remains for ever. How can you say that the Son of man must be lifted up? Who is this Son of man?”
verses.heading: Jesus Speaks about His Death

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “The light is with you for a little longer. Walk while you have the light, lest the darkness overtake you; he who walks in the darkness does not know where he goes.
verses.heading: Jesus Speaks about His Death

verses.text: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become sons of light.”
verses.heading: Jesus Speaks about His Death

verses.text: Though he had done so many signs before them, yet they did not believe in him;
verses.heading: The Unbelief of the People

verses.text: it was that the word spoken by the prophet Isaiah might be fulfilled: “Lord, who has believed our report, and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
verses.heading: The Unbelief of the People

verses.text: Therefore they could not believe. For Isaiah again said,
verses.heading: The Unbelief of the People

verses.text: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes and perceive with their heart, and turn for me to heal them.”
verses.heading: The Unbelief of the People

verses.text: Isaiah said this because he saw his glory and spoke of him.
verses.heading: The Unbelief of the People

verses.text: Nevertheless many even of the authorities believed in him, but for fear of the Pharisees they did not confess it, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
verses.heading: The Unbelief of the People

verses.text: for they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
verses.heading: The Unbelief of the People

verses.text: And Jesus cried out and said, “He who believes in me, believes not in me but in him who sent me.
verses.heading: Summary of Jesus’ Teaching

verses.text: And he who sees me sees him who sent me.
verses.heading: Summary of Jesus’ Teaching

verses.text: I have come as light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in darkness.
verses.heading: Summary of Jesus’ Teaching

verses.text: If any one hears my sayings and does not keep them, I do not judge him; for I did not come to judge the world but to save the world.
verses.heading: Summary of Jesus’ Teaching

verses.text: He who rejects me and does not receive my sayings has a judge; the word that I have spoken will be his judge on the last day.
verses.heading: Summary of Jesus’ Teaching

verses.text: For I have not spoken on my own authority; the Father who sent me has himself given me commandment what to say and what to speak.
verses.heading: Summary of Jesus’ Teaching

verses.text: And I know that his commandment is eternal life. What I say, therefore, I say as the Father has bidden me.”
verses.heading: Summary of Jesus’ Teaching

verses.text: Now before the feast of the Passover, when Jesus knew that his hour had come to depart out of this world to the Father, having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: And during supper, when the devil had already put it into the heart of Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, to betray him,
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he had come from God and was going to God,
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: rose from supper, laid aside his garments, and tied a towel around himself.
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: Then he poured water into a basin, and began to wash the disciples’ feet, and to wipe them with the towel that was tied around him.
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: He came to Simon Peter; and Peter said to him, “Lord, do you wash my feet?”
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: Jesus answered him, “What I am doing you do not know now, but afterward you will understand.”
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: Peter said to him, “You shall never wash my feet.” Jesus answered him, “If I do not wash you, you have no part in me.”
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, not my feet only but also my hands and my head!”
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “He who has bathed does not need to wash, except for his feet, but he is clean all over; and you are clean, but not all of you.”
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: For he knew who was to betray him; that was why he said, “You are not all clean.”
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: When he had washed their feet, and taken his garments, and resumed his place, he said to them, “Do you know what I have done to you?
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: You call me Teacher and Lord; and you are right, for so I am.
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: If I then, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also ought to wash one another’s feet.
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: For I have given you an example, that you also should do as I have done to you.
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, a servant is not greater than his master; nor is he who is sent greater than he who sent him.
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: If you know these things, blessed are you if you do them.
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: I am not speaking of you all; I know whom I have chosen; it is that the Scripture may be fulfilled, ‘He who ate my bread has lifted his heel against me.’
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: I tell you this now, before it takes place, that when it does take place you may believe that I am he.
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, he who receives any one whom I send receives me; and he who receives me receives him who sent me.”
verses.heading: Jesus Washes the Disciples’ Feet

verses.text: When Jesus had thus spoken, he was troubled in spirit, and testified, “Truly, truly, I say to you, one of you will betray me.”
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Betrayal

verses.text: The disciples looked at one another, uncertain of whom he spoke.
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Betrayal

verses.text: One of his disciples, whom Jesus loved, was lying close to the breast of Jesus;
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Betrayal

verses.text: so Simon Peter beckoned to him and said, “Tell us who it is of whom he speaks.”
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Betrayal

verses.text: So lying thus, close to the breast of Jesus, he said to him, “Lord, who is it?”
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Betrayal

verses.text: Jesus answered, “It is he to whom I shall give this morsel when I have dipped it.” So when he had dipped the morsel, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Betrayal

verses.text: Then after the morsel, Satan entered into him. Jesus said to him, “What you are going to do, do quickly.”
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Betrayal

verses.text: Now no one at the table knew why he said this to him.
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Betrayal

verses.text: Some thought that, because Judas had the money box, Jesus was telling him, “Buy what we need for the feast”; or, that he should give something to the poor.
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Betrayal

verses.text: So, after receiving the morsel, he immediately went out; and it was night.
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells His Betrayal

verses.text: When he had gone out, Jesus said, “Now is the Son of man glorified, and in him God is glorified;
verses.heading: The New Commandment

verses.text: if God is glorified in him, God will also glorify him in himself, and glorify him at once.
verses.heading: The New Commandment

verses.text: Little children, yet a little while I am with you. You will seek me; and as I said to the Jews so now I say to you, ‘Where I am going you cannot come.’
verses.heading: The New Commandment

verses.text: A new commandment I give to you, that you love one another; even as I have loved you, that you also love one another.
verses.heading: The New Commandment

verses.text: By this all men will know that you are my disciples, if you have love for one another.”
verses.heading: The New Commandment

verses.text: Simon Peter said to him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus answered, “Where I am going you cannot follow me now; but you shall follow afterward.”
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells Peter’s Denial

verses.text: Peter said to him, “Lord, why can I not follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells Peter’s Denial

verses.text: Jesus answered, “Will you lay down your life for me? Truly, truly, I say to you, the cock will not crow, till you have denied me three times.
verses.heading: Jesus Foretells Peter’s Denial

headings.title: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life
The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: “Let not your hearts be troubled; believe in God, believe also in me.
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: In my Father’s house are many rooms; if it were not so, would I have told you that I go to prepare a place for you?
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: And when I go and prepare a place for you, I will come again and will take you to myself, that where I am you may be also.
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: And you know the way where I am going.”
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we do not know where you are going; how can we know the way?”
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “I am the way, and the truth, and the life; no one comes to the Father, but by me.
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: If you had known me, you would have known my Father also; henceforth you know him and have seen him.”
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: Philip said to him, “Lord, show us the Father, and we shall be satisfied.”
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “Have I been with you so long, and yet you do not know me, Philip? He who has seen me has seen the Father; how can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: Do you not believe that I am in the Father and the Father is in me? The words that I say to you I do not speak on my own authority; but the Father who dwells in me does his works.
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: Believe me that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or else believe me for the sake of the works themselves.
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: “Truly, truly, I say to you, he who believes in me will also do the works that I do; and greater works than these will he do, because I go to the Father.
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: Whatever you ask in my name, I will do it, that the Father may be glorified in the Son;
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: if you ask anything in my name, I will do it.
verses.heading: Jesus the Way, the Truth, and the Life

verses.text: “If you love me, you will keep my commandments.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another Counselor, to be with you for ever,
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: even the Spirit of truth, whom the world cannot receive, because it neither sees him nor knows him; you know him, for he dwells with you, and will be in you.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: “I will not leave you desolate; I will come to you.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: Yet a little while, and the world will see me no more, but you will see me; because I live, you will live also.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: In that day you will know that I am in my Father, and you in me, and I in you.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: He who has my commandments and keeps them, he it is who loves me; and he who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I will love him and manifest myself to him.”
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: Judas (not Iscariot) said to him, “Lord, how is it that you will manifest yourself to us, and not to the world?”
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: Jesus answered him, “If a man loves me, he will keep my word, and my Father will love him, and we will come to him and make our home with him.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: He who does not love me does not keep my words; and the word which you hear is not mine but the Father’s who sent me.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: “These things I have spoken to you, while I am still with you.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: But the Counselor, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, he will teach you all things, and bring to your remembrance all that I have said to you.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give to you; not as the world gives do I give to you. Let not your hearts be troubled, neither let them be afraid.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: You heard me say to you, ‘I go away, and I will come to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I go to the Father; for the Father is greater than I.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: And now I have told you before it takes place, so that when it does take place, you may believe.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: I will no longer talk much with you, for the ruler of this world is coming. He has no power over me;
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: but I do as the Father has commanded me, so that the world may know that I love the Father. Rise, let us go from here.
verses.heading: The Promise of the Holy Spirit

verses.text: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the vinedresser.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: Every branch of mine that bears no fruit, he takes away, and every branch that does bear fruit he prunes, that it may bear more fruit.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: You are already made clean by the word which I have spoken to you.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: Abide in me, and I in you. As the branch cannot bear fruit by itself, unless it abides in the vine, neither can you, unless you abide in me.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: I am the vine, you are the branches. He who abides in me, and I in him, he it is that bears much fruit, for apart from me you can do nothing.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: If a man does not abide in me, he is cast forth as a branch and withers; and the branches are gathered, thrown into the fire and burned.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: If you abide in me, and my words abide in you, ask whatever you will, and it shall be done for you.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: By this my Father is glorified, that you bear much fruit, and so prove to be my disciples.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you; abide in my love.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: If you keep my commandments, you will abide in my love, just as I have kept my Father’s commandments and abide in his love.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: These things I have spoken to you, that my joy may be in you, and that your joy may be full.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: “This is my commandment, that you love one another as I have loved you.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: Greater love has no man than this, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: You are my friends if you do what I command you.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: No longer do I call you servants, for the servant does not know what his master is doing; but I have called you friends, for all that I have heard from my Father I have made known to you.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you that you should go and bear fruit and that your fruit should abide; so that whatever you ask the Father in my name, he may give it to you.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: This I command you, to love one another.
verses.heading: Jesus the True Vine

verses.text: “If the world hates you, know that it has hated me before it hated you.
verses.heading: The World’s Hatred

verses.text: If you were of the world, the world would love its own; but because you are not of the world, but I chose you out of the world, therefore the world hates you.
verses.heading: The World’s Hatred

verses.text: Remember the word that I said to you, ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted me, they will persecute you; if they kept my word, they will keep yours also.
verses.heading: The World’s Hatred

verses.text: But all this they will do to you on my account, because they do not know him who sent me.
verses.heading: The World’s Hatred

verses.text: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not have sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
verses.heading: The World’s Hatred

verses.text: He who hates me hates my Father also.
verses.heading: The World’s Hatred

verses.text: If I had not done among them the works which no one else did, they would not have sin; but now they have seen and hated both me and my Father.
verses.heading: The World’s Hatred

verses.text: It is to fulfil the word that is written in their law, ‘They hated me without a cause.’
verses.heading: The World’s Hatred

verses.text: But when the Counselor comes, whom I shall send to you from the Father, even the Spirit of truth, who proceeds from the Father, he will bear witness to me;
verses.heading: The World’s Hatred

verses.text: and you also are witnesses, because you have been with me from the beginning.
verses.heading: The World’s Hatred

verses.text: “I have said all this to you to keep you from falling away.
They will put you out of the synagogues; indeed, the hour is coming when whoever kills you will think he is offering service to God.
And they will do this because they have not known the Father, nor me.
But I have said these things to you, that when their hour comes you may remember that I told you of them.
But now I am going to him who sent me; yet none of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
verses.heading: The Work of the Spirit

verses.text: But because I have said these things to you, sorrow has filled your hearts.
verses.heading: The Work of the Spirit

verses.text: Nevertheless I tell you the truth: it is to your advantage that I go away, for if I do not go away, the Counselor will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.
verses.heading: The Work of the Spirit

verses.text: And when he comes, he will convince the world of sin and of righteousness and of judgment:
verses.heading: The Work of the Spirit

verses.text: of sin, because they do not believe in me;
verses.heading: The Work of the Spirit

verses.text: of righteousness, because I go to the Father, and you will see me no more;
verses.heading: The Work of the Spirit

verses.text: of judgment, because the ruler of this world is judged.
verses.heading: The Work of the Spirit

verses.text: “I have yet many things to say to you, but you cannot bear them now.
verses.heading: The Work of the Spirit

verses.text: When the Spirit of truth comes, he will guide you into all the truth; for he will not speak on his own authority, but whatever he hears he will speak, and he will declare to you the things that are to come.
verses.heading: The Work of the Spirit

verses.text: He will glorify me, for he will take what is mine and declare it to you.
verses.heading: The Work of the Spirit

verses.text: All that the Father has is mine; therefore I said that he will take what is mine and declare it to you.
verses.heading: The Work of the Spirit

verses.text: “A little while, and you will see me no more; again a little while, and you will see me.”
verses.heading: Sorrow Will Turn into Joy

verses.text: Some of his disciples said to one another, “What is this that he says to us, ‘A little while, and you will not see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’; and, ‘because I go to the Father’?”
verses.heading: Sorrow Will Turn into Joy

verses.text: They said, “What does he mean by ‘a little while’? We do not know what he means.”
verses.heading: Sorrow Will Turn into Joy

verses.text: Jesus knew that they wanted to ask him; so he said to them, “Is this what you are asking yourselves, what I meant by saying, ‘A little while, and you will not see me, and again a little while, and you will see me’?
verses.heading: Sorrow Will Turn into Joy

verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, you will weep and lament, but the world will rejoice; you will be sorrowful, but your sorrow will turn into joy.
verses.heading: Sorrow Will Turn into Joy

verses.text: When a woman is in labor, she has pain, because her hour has come; but when she is delivered of the child, she no longer remembers the anguish, for joy that a child is born into the world.
verses.heading: Sorrow Will Turn into Joy

verses.text: So you have sorrow now, but I will see you again and your hearts will rejoice, and no one will take your joy from you.
verses.heading: Sorrow Will Turn into Joy

verses.text: In that day you will ask nothing of me. Truly, truly, I say to you, if you ask anything of the Father, he will give it to you in my name.
verses.heading: Sorrow Will Turn into Joy

verses.text: Until now you have asked nothing in my name; ask, and you will receive, that your joy may be full.
verses.heading: Sorrow Will Turn into Joy

verses.text: “I have said this to you in figures; the hour is coming when I shall no longer speak to you in figures but tell you plainly of the Father.
verses.heading: Peace for the Disciples

verses.text: In that day you will ask in my name; and I do not say to you that I shall ask the Father for you;
verses.heading: Peace for the Disciples

verses.text: for the Father himself loves you, because you have loved me and have believed that I came from the Father.
verses.heading: Peace for the Disciples

verses.text: I came from the Father and have come into the world; again, I am leaving the world and going to the Father.”
verses.heading: Peace for the Disciples

verses.text: His disciples said, “Ah, now you are speaking plainly, not in any figure!
verses.heading: Peace for the Disciples

verses.text: Now we know that you know all things, and need none to question you; by this we believe that you came from God.”
verses.heading: Peace for the Disciples

verses.text: Jesus answered them, “Do you now believe?
verses.heading: Peace for the Disciples

verses.text: The hour is coming, indeed it has come, when you will be scattered, every man to his home, and will leave me alone; yet I am not alone, for the Father is with me.
verses.heading: Peace for the Disciples

verses.text: I have said this to you, that in me you may have peace. In the world you have tribulation; but be of good cheer, I have overcome the world.”
verses.heading: Peace for the Disciples

verses.text: When Jesus had spoken these words, he lifted up his eyes to heaven and said, “Father, the hour has come; glorify your Son that the Son may glorify you,
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: since you have given him power over all flesh, to give eternal life to all whom you have given him.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: And this is eternal life, that they know you the only true God, and Jesus Christ whom you have sent.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: I glorified you on earth, having accomplished the work which you gave me to do;
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: and now, Father, glorify me in your own presence with the glory which I had with you before the world was made.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: “I have manifested your name to the men whom you gave me out of the world; they were yours, and you gave them to me, and they have kept your word.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: Now they know that everything that you have given me is from you;
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: for I have given them the words which you gave me, and they have received them and know in truth that I came from you; and they have believed that you sent me.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: I am praying for them; I am not praying for the world but for those whom you have given me, for they are yours;
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: all mine are yours, and yours are mine, and I am glorified in them.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: And now I am no more in the world, but they are in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, keep them in your name, which you have given me, that they may be one, even as we are one.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: While I was with them, I kept them in your name, which you have given me; I have guarded them, and none of them is lost but the son of perdition, that the Scripture might be fulfilled.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: But now I am coming to you; and these things I speak in the world, that they may have my joy fulfilled in themselves.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: I have given them your word; and the world has hated them because they are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: I do not pray that you should take them out of the world, but that you should keep them from the evil one.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: They are not of the world, even as I am not of the world.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: Sanctify them in the truth; your word is truth.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: As you sent me into the world, so I have sent them into the world.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: And for their sake I consecrate myself, that they also may be consecrated in truth.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: “I do not pray for these only, but also for those who believe in me through their word,
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: that they may all be one; even as you, Father, are in me, and I in you, that they also may be in us, so that the world may believe that you have sent me.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: The glory which you have given me I have given to them, that they may be one even as we are one,
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: I in them and you in me, that they may become perfectly one, so that the world may know that you have sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: Father, I desire that they also, whom you have given me, may be with me where I am, to behold my glory which you have given me in your love for me before the foundation of the world.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: O righteous Father, the world has not known you, but I have known you; and these know that you have sent me.
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: I made known to them your name, and I will make it known, that the love with which you have loved me may be in them, and I in them.”
verses.heading: Jesus Prays for the Church

verses.text: When Jesus had spoken these words, he went forth with his disciples across the Kidron valley, where there was a garden, which he and his disciples entered.
verses.heading: The Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place; for Jesus often met there with his disciples.
verses.heading: The Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: So Judas, procuring a band of soldiers and some officers from the chief priests and the Pharisees, went there with lanterns and torches and weapons.
verses.heading: The Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Then Jesus, knowing all that was to befall him, came forward and said to them, “Whom do you seek?”
verses.heading: The Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: They answered him, “Jesus of Nazareth.” Jesus said to them, “I am he.” Judas, who betrayed him, was standing with them.
verses.heading: The Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: When he said to them, “I am he,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
verses.heading: The Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Again he asked them, “Whom do you seek?” And they said, “Jesus of Nazareth.”
verses.heading: The Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he; so, if you seek me, let these men go.”
verses.heading: The Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: This was to fulfil the word which he had spoken, “Of those whom you gave me I lost not one.”
verses.heading: The Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Then Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it and struck the high priest’s slave and cut off his right ear. The slave’s name was Malchus.
verses.heading: The Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: Jesus said to Peter, “Put your sword into its sheath; shall I not drink the chalice which the Father has given me?”
verses.heading: The Arrest of Jesus

verses.text: So the band of soldiers and their captain and the officers of the Jews seized Jesus and bound him.
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: First they led him to Annas; for he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year.
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: It was Caiaphas who had given counsel to the Jews that it was expedient that one man should die for the people.
verses.heading: Jesus before the High Priest

verses.text: Simon Peter followed Jesus, and so did another disciple. As this disciple was known to the high priest, he entered the court of the high priest along with Jesus,
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: while Peter stood outside at the door. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to the maid who kept the door, and brought Peter in.
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: The maid who kept the door said to Peter, “Are not you also one of this man’s disciples?” He said, “I am not.”
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: Now the servants and officers had made a charcoal fire, because it was cold, and they were standing and warming themselves; Peter also was with them, standing and warming himself.
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus

verses.text: The high priest then questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.
verses.heading: The High Priest Questions Jesus

verses.text: Jesus answered him, “I have spoken openly to the world; I have always taught in synagogues and in the temple, where all Jews come together; I have said nothing secretly.
verses.heading: The High Priest Questions Jesus

verses.text: Why do you ask me? Ask those who have heard me, what I said to them; they know what I said.”
verses.heading: The High Priest Questions Jesus

verses.text: When he had said this, one of the officers standing by struck Jesus with his hand, saying, “Is that how you answer the high priest?”
verses.heading: The High Priest Questions Jesus

verses.text: Jesus answered him, “If I have spoken wrongly, bear witness to the wrong; but if I have spoken rightly, why do you strike me?”
verses.heading: The High Priest Questions Jesus

verses.text: Annas then sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
verses.heading: The High Priest Questions Jesus

verses.text: Now Simon Peter was standing and warming himself. They said to him, “Are not you also one of his disciples?” He denied it and said, “I am not.”
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus Again

verses.text: One of the servants of the high priest, a kinsman of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, asked, “Did I not see you in the garden with him?”
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus Again

verses.text: Peter again denied it; and at once the cock crowed.
verses.heading: Peter Denies Jesus Again

verses.text: Then they led Jesus from the house of Caiaphas to the praetorium. It was early. They themselves did not enter the praetorium, so that they might not be defiled, but might eat the Passover.
verses.heading: Jesus before Pilate

verses.text: So Pilate went out to them and said, “What accusation do you bring against this man?”
verses.heading: Jesus before Pilate

verses.text: They answered him, “If this man were not an evildoer, we would not have handed him over.”
verses.heading: Jesus before Pilate

verses.text: Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and judge him by your own law.” The Jews said to him, “It is not lawful for us to put any man to death.”
verses.heading: Jesus before Pilate

verses.text: This was to fulfil the word which Jesus had spoken to show by what death he was to die.
verses.heading: Jesus before Pilate

verses.text: Pilate entered the praetorium again and called Jesus, and said to him, “Are you the King of the Jews?”
verses.heading: Jesus Sentenced to Death

verses.text: Jesus answered, “Do you say this of your own accord, or did others say it to you about me?”
verses.heading: Jesus Sentenced to Death

verses.text: Pilate answered, “Am I a Jew? Your own nation and the chief priests have handed you over to me; what have you done?”
verses.heading: Jesus Sentenced to Death

verses.text: Jesus answered, “My kingship is not of this world; if my kingship were of this world, my servants would fight, that I might not be handed over to the Jews; but my kingship is not from the world.”
verses.heading: Jesus Sentenced to Death

verses.text: Pilate said to him, “So you are a king?” Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. For this I was born, and for this I have come into the world, to bear witness to the truth. Every one who is of the truth hears my voice.”
verses.heading: Jesus Sentenced to Death

verses.text: Pilate said to him, “What is truth?” After he had said this, he went out to the Jews again, and told them, “I find no crime in him.
verses.heading: Jesus Sentenced to Death

verses.text: But you have a custom that I should release one man for you at the Passover; will you have me release for you the King of the Jews?”
verses.heading: Jesus Sentenced to Death

verses.text: They cried out again, “Not this man, but Barabbas!” Now Barabbas was a robber.
verses.heading: Jesus Sentenced to Death

verses.text: Then Pilate took Jesus and scourged him.
And the soldiers plaited a crown of thorns, and put it on his head, and clothed him in a purple robe;
they came up to him, saying, “Hail, King of the Jews!” and struck him with their hands.
Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I am bringing him out to you, that you may know that I find no crime in him.”
So Jesus came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe. Pilate said to them, “Here is the man!”
When the chief priests and the officers saw him, they cried out, “Crucify him, crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Take him yourselves and crucify him, for I find no crime in him.”
The Jews answered him, “We have a law, and by that law he ought to die, because he has made himself the Son of God.”
When Pilate heard these words, he was even more afraid;
he entered the praetorium again and said to Jesus, “Where are you from?” But Jesus gave no answer.
Pilate therefore said to him, “You will not speak to me? Do you not know that I have power to release you, and power to crucify you?”
Jesus answered him, “You would have no power over me unless it had been given you from above; therefore he who delivered me to you has the greater sin.”
Upon this Pilate sought to release him, but the Jews cried out, “If you release this man, you are not Caesar’s friend; every one who makes himself a king sets himself against Caesar.”
When Pilate heard these words, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgment seat at a place called The Pavement, and in Hebrew, Gabbatha.
Now it was the day of Preparation of the Passover; it was about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Here is your King!”
They cried out, “Away with him, away with him, crucify him!” Pilate said to them, “Shall I crucify your King?” The chief priests answered, “We have no king but Caesar.”
Then he handed him over to them to be crucified.
So they took Jesus, and he went out, bearing his own cross, to the place called the place of a skull, which is called in Hebrew Golgotha.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: There they crucified him, and with him two others, one on either side, and Jesus between them.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: Pilate also wrote a title and put it on the cross; it read, “Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews.”
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: Many of the Jews read this title, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city; and it was written in Hebrew, in Latin, and in Greek.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: The chief priests of the Jews then said to Pilate, “Do not write, ‘The King of the Jews,’ but, ‘This man said, I am King of the Jews.’”
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: Pilate answered, “What I have written I have written.”
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: When the soldiers had crucified Jesus they took his garments and made four parts, one for each soldier; also his tunic. But the tunic was without seam, woven from top to bottom;
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: so they said to one another, “Let us not tear it, but cast lots for it to see whose it shall be.” This was to fulfil the Scripture, “They parted my garments among them, and for my clothing they cast lots.”
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: So the soldiers did this. But standing by the cross of Jesus were his mother, and his mother’s sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: When Jesus saw his mother, and the disciple whom he loved standing near, he said to his mother, “Woman, behold, your son!”
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: Then he said to the disciple, “Behold, your mother!” And from that hour the disciple took her to his own home.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: After this Jesus, knowing that all was now finished, said (to fulfil the Scripture), “I thirst.”
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: A bowl full of vinegar stood there; so they put a sponge full of the vinegar on hyssop and held it to his mouth.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: When Jesus had received the vinegar, he said, “It is finished”; and he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
verses.heading: The Crucifixion

verses.text: Since it was the day of Preparation, in order to prevent the bodies from remaining on the cross on the sabbath (for that sabbath was a high day), the Jews asked Pilate that their legs might be broken, and that they might be taken away.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Side Is Pierced

verses.text: So the soldiers came and broke the legs of the first, and of the other who had been crucified with him;
verses.heading: Jesus’ Side Is Pierced

verses.text: but when they came to Jesus and saw that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Side Is Pierced

verses.text: But one of the soldiers pierced his side with a spear, and at once there came out blood and water.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Side Is Pierced

verses.text: He who saw it has borne witness—his testimony is true, and he knows that he tells the truth—that you also may believe.
verses.heading: Jesus’ Side Is Pierced

verses.text: For these things took place that the Scripture might be fulfilled, “Not a bone of him shall be broken.”
verses.heading: Jesus’ Side Is Pierced

verses.text: And again another Scripture says, “They shall look on him whom they have pierced.”
verses.heading: Jesus’ Side Is Pierced

verses.text: After this Joseph of Arimathea, who was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly, for fear of the Jews, asked Pilate that he might take away the body of Jesus, and Pilate gave him leave. So he came and took away his body.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: Nicodemus also, who had at first come to him by night, came bringing a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about a hundred pounds’ weight.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: They took the body of Jesus, and bound it in linen cloths with the spices, as is the burial custom of the Jews.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: Now in the place where he was crucified there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb where no one had ever been laid.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

verses.text: So because of the Jewish day of Preparation, as the tomb was close at hand, they laid Jesus there.
verses.heading: The Burial of Jesus

headings.title: Jesus Gives the Disciples the Power to Forgive Sins

verses.text: Now on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene came to the tomb early, while it was still dark, and saw that the stone had been taken away from the tomb.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: So she ran, and went to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one whom Jesus loved, and said to them, “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we do not know where they have laid him.”
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: Peter then came out with the other disciple, and they went toward the tomb.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: They both ran, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first;
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: and stooping to look in, he saw the linen cloths lying there, but he did not go in.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: Then Simon Peter came, following him, and went into the tomb; he saw the linen cloths lying,
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: and the napkin, which had been on his head, not lying with the linen cloths but rolled up in a place by itself.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: Then the other disciple, who reached the tomb first, also went in, and he saw and believed;
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: for as yet they did not know the Scripture, that he must rise from the dead.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: Then the disciples went back to their homes.
verses.heading: The Resurrection of Jesus

verses.text: But Mary stood weeping outside the tomb, and as she wept she stooped to look into the tomb;
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene

verses.text: and she saw two angels in white, sitting where the body of Jesus had lain, one at the head and one at the feet.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene

verses.text: They said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping?” She said to them, “Because they have taken away my Lord, and I do not know where they have laid him.”
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene

verses.text: Saying this, she turned round and saw Jesus standing, but she did not know that it was Jesus.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene

verses.text: Jesus said to her, “Woman, why are you weeping? Whom do you seek?” Supposing him to be the gardener, she said to him, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have laid him, and I will take him away.”
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene

verses.text: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned and said to him in Hebrew, “Rab-boni!” (which means Teacher).
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene

verses.text: Jesus said to her, “Do not hold me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father; but go to my brethren and say to them, I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.”
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene

verses.text: Mary Magdalene went and said to the disciples, “I have seen the Lord”; and she told them that he had said these things to her.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Mary Magdalene

verses.text: On the evening of that day, the first day of the week, the doors being shut where the disciples were, for fear of the Jews, Jesus came and stood among them and said to them, “Peace be with you.”
verses.heading: Jesus Gives the Disciples the Power to Forgive Sins

verses.text: When he had said this, he showed them his hands and his side. Then the disciples were glad when they saw the Lord.
verses.heading: Jesus Gives the Disciples the Power to Forgive Sins

verses.text: Jesus said to them again, “Peace be with you. As the Father has sent me, even so I send you.”
verses.heading: Jesus Gives the Disciples the Power to Forgive Sins

verses.text: And when he had said this, he breathed on them, and said to them, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
verses.heading: Jesus Gives the Disciples the Power to Forgive Sins

verses.text: If you forgive the sins of any, they are forgiven; if you retain the sins of any, they are retained.”
verses.heading: Jesus Gives the Disciples the Power to Forgive Sins

verses.text: Now Thomas, one of the Twelve, called the Twin, was not with them when Jesus came.
verses.heading: Jesus and Thomas

verses.text: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord.” But he said to them, “Unless I see in his hands the print of the nails, and place my finger in the mark of the nails, and place my hand in his side, I will not believe.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Thomas

verses.text: Eight days later, his disciples were again in the house, and Thomas was with them. The doors were shut, but Jesus came and stood among them, and said, “Peace be with you.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Thomas

verses.text: Then he said to Thomas, “Put your finger here, and see my hands; and put out your hand, and place it in my side; do not be faithless, but believing.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Thomas

verses.text: Thomas answered him, “My Lord and my God!”
verses.heading: Jesus and Thomas

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “You have believed because you have seen me. Blessed are those who have not seen and yet believe.”
verses.heading: Jesus and Thomas

verses.text: Now Jesus did many other signs in the presence of the disciples, which are not written in this book;
verses.heading: The Purpose of This Book

verses.text: but these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Christ, the Son of God, and that believing you may have life in his name.
verses.heading: The Purpose of This Book

headings.title: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: After this Jesus revealed himself again to the disciples by the Sea of Tiberi-as; and he revealed himself in this way.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: Simon Peter, Thomas called the Twin, Nathana-el of Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two others of his disciples were together.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: Simon Peter said to them, “I am going fishing.” They said to him, “We will go with you.” They went out and got into the boat; but that night they caught nothing.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: Just as day was breaking, Jesus stood on the beach; yet the disciples did not know that it was Jesus.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “Children, have you any fish?” They answered him, “No.”
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: He said to them, “Cast the net on the right side of the boat, and you will find some.” So they cast it, and now they were not able to haul it in, for the quantity of fish.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: That disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” When Simon Peter heard that it was the Lord, he put on his clothes, for he was stripped for work, and sprang into the sea.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: But the other disciples came in the boat, dragging the net full of fish, for they were not far from the land, but about a hundred yards off.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: When they got out on land, they saw a charcoal fire there, with fish lying on it, and bread.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish that you have just caught.”
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: So Simon Peter went aboard and hauled the net ashore, full of large fish, a hundred and fifty-three of them; and although there were so many, the net was not torn.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: Jesus said to them, “Come and have breakfast.” Now none of the disciples dared ask him, “Who are you?” They knew it was the Lord.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: Jesus came and took the bread and gave it to them, and so with the fish.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: This was now the third time that Jesus was revealed to the disciples after he was raised from the dead.
verses.heading: Jesus Appears to Disciples by the Sea of Tiberias

verses.text: When they had finished breakfast, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon, son of John, do you love me more than these?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I love you.” He said to him, “Feed my lambs.”
verses.heading: Peter Is Given a Command

verses.text: A second time he said to him, “Simon, son of John, do you love me?” He said to him, “Yes, Lord; you know that I love you.” He said to him, “Tend my sheep.”
verses.heading: Peter Is Given a Command

verses.text: He said to him the third time, “Simon, son of John, do you love me?” Peter was grieved because he said to him the third time, “Do you love me?” And he said to him, “Lord, you know everything; you know that I love you.” Jesus said to him, “Feed my sheep.
verses.heading: Peter Is Given a Command

verses.text: Truly, truly, I say to you, when you were young, you fastened your own belt and walked where you would; but when you are old, you will stretch out your hands, and another will fasten your belt for you and carry you where you do not wish to go.”
verses.heading: Peter Is Given a Command

verses.text: (This he said to show by what death he was to glorify God.) And after this he said to him, “Follow me.”
verses.heading: Peter Is Given a Command

verses.text: Peter turned and saw following them the disciple whom Jesus loved, who had lain close to his breast at the supper and had said, “Lord, who is it that is going to betray you?”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Beloved Disciple

verses.text: When Peter saw him, he said to Jesus, “Lord, what about this man?”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Beloved Disciple

verses.text: Jesus said to him, “If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you? Follow me!”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Beloved Disciple

verses.text: The saying spread abroad among the brethren that this disciple was not to die; yet Jesus did not say to him that he was not to die, but, “If it is my will that he remain until I come, what is that to you?”
verses.heading: Jesus and the Beloved Disciple

verses.text: This is the disciple who is bearing witness to these things, and who has written these things; and we know that his testimony is true.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Beloved Disciple

verses.text: But there are also many other things which Jesus did; were every one of them to be written, I suppose that the world itself could not contain the books that would be written.
verses.heading: Jesus and the Beloved Disciple
